scripts.contracts:bundle: redocly bundle contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml --config contracts/openapi/redocly.yaml --output contracts/openapi/dist/openapi.json --ext json
scripts.generate:ts: node scripts/prepare-openapi-models.mjs contracts/openapi/dist/openapi.json contracts/openapi/dist/openapi-models.json && openapi --input contracts/openapi/dist/openapi-models.json --output frontend/src/api/generated --useUnionTypes --exportCore false --exportServices false --exportModels true --indent 2 && node scripts/generate-openapi-path-types.mjs contracts/openapi/dist/openapi.json frontend/src/api/generated/schema.ts frontend/src/api/generated/contract-meta.ts && node scripts/normalize-openapi-generated.mjs frontend/src/api/generated
scripts.generate:api: pnpm contracts:lint && pnpm contracts:bundle && pnpm generate:go && pnpm generate:ts
